meta.title: Lily's Password
meta.textType: story told as an email for a clear reader

paragraphs: Subject: Our new reading software. Dear Grace, Hello from Thailand! How are you? This week, my class started a new reading software on the school computers. It was a big week at school, and I have a lot to tell you. I want to tell you about the software, because you love books too.

On Monday, Teacher Kim took us to the computer room. It is cool and quiet, and each child has a small desk. Everybody got a yellow card with a password on it. I put my card in my notebook and closed it. The software has many stories, and it has a textbook for English too. The textbook is on the screen, so we do not carry a heavy bag. The first story was about a girl and a small boat. Mia loves the pictures, and Leo likes the word games. "I like this, but football is better," said Leo. Teacher Kim laughed and said, "Let us try both."

On Wednesday, I had a problem. It was very hot, so we had an indoor break in the hall. The sun was high, and the school field was too hot for games. I sat on a bench with Mia, and we ate fruit. After the break, I wanted to read my story, but I forgot my password. The computer room was shut, and my notebook was inside. "I know mine by heart," said Leo. I did not answer, and I waited by the door. I looked at the floor and thought about my yellow card.

Ten minutes later, Teacher Kim came with a key. She opened the door and smiled. "Please do not worry, Lily," she said. She said, "The room is shut at break to keep the computers safe." I opened my notebook, and the yellow card was in it. I typed the password, and my story opened on the screen. "Next time, write your password in two places," said Mia.

Now I keep the card in my notebook, and I put a small star on that page. I will continue to read one story every evening. Does your class have a reading software too? Do you have a password, and do you forget it? Please write to me and tell me about your school. Your friend, Lily.
text.summary: Lily writes an email to her pen pal Grace about the new reading software at school. She forgets her password, the computer room is shut, and Teacher Kim helps her.
